{{Quote|Magnificent, aren't they?|[[Lama Su/Legends|Lama Su]], on the Clone Army, including 6/298|<ref name="Card">{{TCG|set=Sith Rising|cardname=Clone trooper 6/298|link=https://swtcg.com/Content/Images/Cards/SR/SR035_Clone_trooper_6_298.webp?v=2}}</ref>}}
'''6/298''' was a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]]. 6/298 participated in the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|First Battle]] of [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]], and was one of the [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] who assisted in the rescue of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu's]] [[Jedi assault team/Legends|strike team]] from the [[Petranaki arena]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Around the survivors, a perimeter create.|[[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]], to 6/298's [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry/Legends|LAAT/i]] [[Clone trooper pilot/Legends|pilot]]|<ref name="SWE2" />}}
[[Cloning/Legends|Born]] on the [[Waterworld/Legends|aquatic]] planet of [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] as a clone of the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]], 6/298 was created to fight as a clone trooper for the Grand Army of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]].<ref name="SWE" /> 6/298 was amongst<ref name="Card" /> the troopers moving in formation when [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] visited Kamino<ref name="SWE2" /> in [[22 BBY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> exposing the existence of the clone army for the first time. Standing with Kenobi, [[Prime Minister/Legends|Prime Minister]] [[Lama Su/Legends|Lama Su]] declared the clones below,<ref name="SWE2" /> including 6/298, to be magnificent.<ref name="Card" />

Shortly thereafter, following the capture of [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]], Kenobi, and [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], a [[Jedi assault team/Legends|strike team]]<ref name="SWE2" /> of 200 Jedi<ref name="ITW:AOTC">''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars: Attack of the Clones]]''</ref> were deployed to the rocky world of Geonosis to rescue the three captives, and investigate reports of a growing [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[Droid Army|army]] on the planet.<ref name="SWE2" /> To aid in the Jedi's efforts, [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] deployed an army of 190,000 clone troopers<ref name="ITW:AOTC" /> to assist in destroying the Separatist threat.<ref name="SWE2" />

As one of the many clone troopers sent to Geonosis, 6/298 was assigned to escort [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]] Yoda aboard a LAAT/i gunship. Upon breaking through the [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosian]] blockade, 6/298's ship headed towards the [[Petranaki/Legends|Petranaki]] arena to rescue the Jedi strike team sent there. Once they had reached the arena, Yoda ordered the gunship to form a perimeter around the few remaining Jedi who had survived the battle. 6/298 exited the LAAT/i, and provided covering fire for fleeing Jedi. While covering the Jedi's escape, 6/298 managed to destroy a [[Droideka/Legends|droideka]] before re-entering his gunship. After rescuing Jedi Masters [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]], [[Kit Fisto/Legends|Kit Fisto]], and [[Ki-Adi-Mundi/Legends|Ki-Adi-Mundi]], 6/298's gunship headed skyward to regroup with the rest of the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic fleet]] invading the planet.<ref name="SWE2" />

[[File:Forward_Command_Center_AotC.png|thumb|left|250px|6/298 arrives at the forward command center.]]
Flying towards the current battle, 6/298's LAAT/i began taking heavy fire from CIS forces on the ground. 6/298's gunship changed its course and began heading towards a cluster of [[Hardcell-class interstellar transport/Legends|Hardcell-class interstellar transports]]. After taking out the Separatist transport vessels with the help of Kenobi's LAAT/i, 6/298 travelled aboard his gunship until it passed the [[Im'g'twe Hills/Legends|Im'g'twe Hills]].<ref name="ITW:AOTC" /> Witnessing one of the other gunships getting destroyed by Separatist fire, Mace Windu ordered the pilot to land in a nearby Republic assembly area. Once all three rescued Jedi had left the ship to go fight in the ongoing battle, 6/298's gunship took off once again and headed towards the [[Forward Command Center/Legends|forward command center]], under Grand Master Yoda's orders. Having dropped off the [[Jedi General/Legends|General]], 6/298 headed skyward one last time, and went to assist the rest of the clone army.<ref name="SWE2" />

==Personality and traits==
[[File:Destroyer_Droid.jpg|thumb|right|200px|The droideka destroyed by 6/298 during the First Battle of Geonosis.]]
Born as a clone of the bounty hunter known as Jango Fett, 6/298 stood at a height of 1.83 [[Meter/Legends|meters]].<ref name="SWE" /> During the First Battle of Geonosis, 6/298 wore standard issue [[Phase I clone trooper armor/Legends|phase 1]] clone trooper [[Clone trooper armor/Legends|armor]] with no discernible markings. He also carried a [[DC-15A blaster rifle/Legends|DC-15A]] [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]], which he used to destroy a [[W-series droideka/Legends|W-series droideka]].<ref name="SWE2" />

==Behind the scenes==
6/298 originally appeared in the [[2002]] film [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']], where he appeared as an unidentified clone trooper. In [[July]] [[2002]], [[Wizards of the Coast]] released an expansion for their [[Star Wars Trading Card Game|''Star Wars'' Trading Card Game]] called [[Sith Rising]]. In the expansion, a card by the name of "Clone Trooper 6/298" was released, which gave the previously unidentified clone a number.<ref name="Card" /> Like all other clone troopers in ''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'', 6/298 is voiced by [[Temuera Morrison]], and portrayed entirely through computer-generated imagery.<ref name="SWE2" />
